user.title: Light with overrides
user.description: A stand-in for a real light. Its commands set the light's normal state; overrides show something else for a while, then the light returns to the normal state as it is by then.

error.layered: That is already a light with overrides; pick the real light.

abort.already_configured: This light already has a stand-in.

override.name: Override
override.description: Show something else on the light for a while. Setting the same key again extends it; the highest priority wins. When it ends the light shows its normal state as it is then.

key.name: Key
key.description: Names the override, so it can be extended or cancelled.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long; default from the light's options.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Higher wins while several are active.

cancel.name: Cancel override
cancel.description: End an override now (all of them without a key).

key.name: Key
key.description: The override to end; empty ends all.
